items.text: Votes to keep in place the existing system, in which public health coverage is guaranteed to older, disabled, and low-income residents, most others rely on employer or subsidized private insurance, and about 8 percent of residents have no coverage, less the reductions listed under changes.

Votes to keep in place the existing income support, in which mandatory pension schemes replace about 51 percent of an average worker's net earnings and a single adult with no other income is guaranteed about 6 percent of the median income, less the reductions listed under changes.
Called the employer health plan bill a solid first step toward lower costs.
Introduced a bill to replace premium subsidies paid to insurers with personal health accounts that people use to buy their own coverage.

As chair of a group of legislators, released a framework urging the party to pass a bill that makes all non-citizens ineligible for public health coverage for low-income residents, food assistance, and housing assistance, and that ends a dedicated fund for disease prevention.
